<style>
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;font-size:16px}
:root{
  --cream:#F7F3EC;--warm:#EDE8DF;--paper:#FAF8F4;
  --ink:#1A1612;--ink-mid:#4A4540;--ink-light:#8C887F;
  --gold:#B8943F;--gold-light:#D4AF6A;--gold-pale:#F0E4C4;
  --rust:#8B4513;--border:#DDD8CE;
  --ff-serif:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;
  --ff-display:'Playfair Display',serif;
  --ff-body:'Outfit',sans-serif;
}
body{background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--ff-body);font-weight:400;line-height:1.65;overflow-x:hidden}

/* ── CURSOR ── */
.cur-dot{position:fixed;width:8px;height:8px;background:var(--gold);border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none;z-index:9999;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);transition:width .2s,height .2s,background .2s}
.cur-ring{position:fixed;width:36px;height:36px;border:1px solid rgba(184,148,63,.4);border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none;z-index:9998;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);transition:width .3s,height .3s,border-color .3s}

/* ── LOADER ── */
#loader{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9000;background:var(--ink);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:opacity .9s ease,visibility .9s}
#loader.out{opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none}
.ld-inner{text-align:center}
.ld-line{overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:4px}
.ld-line span{display:block;font-family:var(--ff-display);font-size:clamp(2rem,5vw,4rem);font-weight:700;color:var(--cream);transform:translateY(100%);animation:slideUp .7s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) forwards}
.ld-line:nth-child(2) span{animation-delay:.1s;font-style:italic;color:var(--gold-light)}
.ld-bar-wrap{width:200px;height:1px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);margin:24px auto 0;overflow:hidden}
.ld-bar{height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold),var(--gold-light));width:0;animation:barFill 1.4s ease forwards .3s}

/* ── NAV ── */
nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:100;height:68px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 clamp(1.5rem,5vw,5rem);background:rgba(247,243,236,.0);backdrop-filter:blur(0px);border-bottom:1px solid transparent;transition:all .4s ease}
nav.scrolled{background:rgba(247,243,236,.93);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border-color:var(--border)}
.nav-logo{font-family:var(--ff-serif);font-size:1.35rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;opacity:0;animation:fadeDown .6s ease forwards 1.9s}
.nav-logo em{color:var(--gold);font-style:italic}
.nav-links{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:2.5rem;list-style:none;opacity:0;animation:fadeDown .6s ease forwards 2s}
.nav-links a{font-size:.8rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-light);text-decoration:none;transition:color .2s;position:relative}
.nav-links a::after{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:-3px;left:0;right:0;height:1px;background:var(--gold);transform:scaleX(0);transition:transform .25s ease}
.nav-links a:hover{color:var(--ink)}
.nav-links a:hover::after{transform:scaleX(1)}
.nav-cta{background:var(--ink)!important;color:var(--cream)!important;padding:9px 22px;border-radius:2px;font-size:.78rem!important;transition:background .2s!important}
.nav-cta:hover{background:var(--gold)!important}
.nav-cta::after{display:none!important}

/* ── LAYOUT ── */
main{position:relative}
section{padding:clamp(5rem,10vw,8rem) clamp(1.5rem,5vw,5rem)}
.wrap{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto}

/* ── HERO ── */
#hero{min-height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding-top:68px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:var(--paper)}
.hero-bg-text{position:absolute;bottom:-2rem;right:-1rem;font-family:var(--ff-display);font-size:clamp(8rem,18vw,22rem);font-weight:900;color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:1px rgba(184,148,63,.07);line-height:1;pointer-events:none;user-select:none;z-index:0;will-change:transform}
.particle{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold);pointer-events:none;z-index:0;animation:floatParticle linear infinite}
@keyframes floatParticle{0%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(0deg);opacity:0}10%{opacity:.6}90%{opacity:.3}100%{transform:translateY(-120vh) rotate(720deg);opacity:0}}
.hero-inner{position:relative;z-index:1;max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;width:100%;padding:0 clamp(1.5rem,5vw,5rem)}
.hero-meta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:2.5rem;opacity:0;animation:fadeUp .7s ease forwards 1.7s}
.hero-dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold);animation:pulseDot 2.5s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes pulseDot{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(184,148,63,.4)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 8px rgba(184,148,63,0)}}
.hero-meta span{font-size:.78rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold)}
.hero-title{font-family:var(--ff-display);font-size:clamp(3.5rem,8vw,7.5rem);font-weight:900;line-height:.95;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin-bottom:2.5rem}
.hero-title .line{overflow:hidden;display:block}
.hero-title .word{display:inline-block;transform:translateY(110%);animation:slideUp .8s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) forwards}
.hero-title .line:nth-child(1) .word{animation-delay:1.7s}
.hero-title .line:nth-child(2) .word{animation-delay:1.85s;color:var(--gold);font-style:italic}
.hero-title .line:nth-child(3) .word{animation-delay:2s;-webkit-text-stroke:1.5px var(--ink);color:transparent}
.hero-sub{max-width:480px;color:var(--ink-mid);font-size:1.05rem;line-height:1.75;margin-bottom:3rem;opacity:0;animation:fadeUp .7s ease forwards 2.1s}
.hero-sub strong{color:var(--ink);font-weight:500}
.hero-actions{display:flex;gap:1rem;flex-wrap:wrap;opacity:0;animation:fadeUp .7s ease forwards 2.25s}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-family:var(--ff-body);font-weight:500;font-size:.88rem;text-decoration:none;padding:14px 28px;border-radius:2px;transition:all .25s;letter-spacing:.02em;cursor:pointer;border:none}
.btn-ink{background:var(--ink);color:var(--cream);border:1px solid var(--ink)}
.btn-ink:hover{background:var(--gold);border-color:var(--gold);transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(184,148,63,.25)}
.btn-outline{background:transparent;color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--border)}
.btn-outline:hover{border-color:var(--ink-mid);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.hero-scroll{position:absolute;bottom:2.5rem;right:clamp(1.5rem,5vw,5rem);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:10px;opacity:0;animation:fadeUp .6s ease forwards 2.6s}
.hero-scroll span{font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-light);writing-mode:vertical-rl}
.hero-scroll-line{width:1px;height:56px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,var(--gold));animation:scrollPulse 2.5s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes scrollPulse{0%{transform:scaleY(0);transform-origin:top}50%{transform:scaleY(1);transform-origin:top}51%{transform:scaleY(1);transform-origin:bottom}100%{transform:scaleY(0);transform-origin:bottom}}
.hero-stats{display:flex;gap:0;border-top:1px solid var(--border);margin-top:4rem;opacity:0;animation:fadeUp .7s ease forwards 2.4s}
.hero-stat{flex:1;padding:1.5rem 0;border-right:1px solid var(--border);padding-right:2rem}
.hero-stat:not(:first-child){padding-left:2rem}
.hero-stat:last-child{border-right:none}
.stat-n{font-family:var(--ff-display);font-size:2.4rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);line-height:1}
.stat-l{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--ink-light);margin-top:4px;letter-spacing:.04em}

/* ── SECTION HEADER ── */
.s-tag{font-size:.72rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:1rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.s-tag::before{content:'';display:block;width:28px;height:1px;background:var(--gold)}
.s-title{font-family:var(--ff-display);font-size:clamp(2.2rem,5vw,4rem);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1.05;margin-bottom:1.25rem}
.s-title em{color:var(--gold);font-style:italic}
.s-desc{color:var(--ink-mid);font-size:1.02rem;line-height:1.75;max-width:520px;margin-bottom:4rem}

/* ── ABOUT ── */
#about{background:var(--cream)}
.about-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.1fr;gap:6rem;align-items:center}
.about-card{background:var(--warm);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:3rem;position:relative;margin-bottom:1.5rem;transition:transform .4s ease,box-shadow .4s ease}
.about-card:hover{transform:translate(-4px,-4px);box-shadow:8px 8px 0 var(--gold-pale)}
.about-card::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:12px;left:12px;right:-12px;bottom:-12px;border:1px solid var(--gold-pale);z-index:-1;transition:all .4s ease}
.about-card:hover::before{top:16px;left:16px;right:-16px;bottom:-16px}
.about-initial{font-family:var(--ff-display);font-size:6rem;font-weight:900;color:var(--gold-pale);line-height:1;margin-bottom:.5rem;display:block}
.about-name{font-family:var(--ff-serif);font-size:1.6rem;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:.25rem}
.about-role{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--gold);font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase}
.about-loc{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--ink-light);margin-top:.5rem}
.about-chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-top:1.5rem}
.chip{font-size:.76rem;padding:5px 12px;border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--ink-mid);letter-spacing:.03em;transition:all .2s}
.chip:hover{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold)}
.about-text p{color:var(--ink-mid);line-height:1.85;margin-bottom:1.25rem;font-size:1rem}
.about-text p strong{color:var(--ink);font-weight:500}
.about-quote{border-left:2px solid var(--gold);padding-left:1.5rem;margin:2rem 0;font-family:var(--ff-serif);font-size:1.25rem;font-style:italic;color:var(--ink-mid);line-height:1.6}

/* ── SKILLS ── */
#skills{background:var(--ink);color:var(--cream)}
#skills .s-tag{color:var(--gold-light)}
#skills .s-tag::before{background:var(--gold-light)}
#skills .s-title{color:var(--cream)}
#skills .s-title em{color:var(--gold-light)}
#skills .s-desc{color:rgba(250,248,244,.55)}
.skills-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:1px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
.skill-block{background:var(--ink);padding:2.5rem;transition:background .3s;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.skill-block::after{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold),var(--gold-light));transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform .35s ease}
.skill-block:hover{background:#201c14}
.skill-block:hover::after{transform:scaleX(1)}
.skill-cat{font-size:.7rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-light);margin-bottom:1.75rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.skill-cat-icon{width:20px;height:20px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0}
.skill-cat::after{content:'';flex:1;height:1px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
.skill-tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.stag{font-size:.8rem;padding:7px 13px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:rgba(250,248,244,.65);transition:all .25s;letter-spacing:.02em;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;cursor:default}
.stag .ico{width:16px;height:16px;flex-shrink:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.stag .ico svg,.stag .ico img{width:16px;height:16px}
.skill-block:hover .stag{border-color:rgba(184,148,63,.25);color:rgba(250,248,244,.85)}
.skill-block:hover .stag:hover{border-color:var(--gold-light);color:var(--cream);background:rgba(184,148,63,.08);transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}

/* ── PROJECTS ── */
#projects{background:var(--paper)}
.fp-card{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;border:1px solid var(--border);margin-bottom:2rem;overflow:hidden;transition:all .4s ease}
.fp-card:hover{box-shadow:0 16px 56px rgba(26,22,18,.14);transform:translateY(-4px)}
.fp-visual{background:var(--warm);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:3rem;min-height:340px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.fp-visual::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:-40px;right:-40px;width:180px;height:180px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold-pale);opacity:.5;transition:transform .6s ease}
.fp-card:hover .fp-visual::before{transform:scale(1.3)}
.fp-mockup{width:240px;background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:1.25rem;box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(26,22,18,.15);position:relative;z-index:1;transition:transform .4s ease,box-shadow .4s ease}
.fp-card:hover .fp-mockup{transform:rotate(-1deg) scale(1.03);box-shadow:0 16px 48px rgba(26,22,18,.22)}
.fp-mockup-bar{display:flex;gap:4px;margin-bottom:10px}
.fp-mockup-bar i{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;display:block}
.fm-r{background:#FF6B6B}.fm-y{background:#FFD93D}.fm-g{background:#6BCB77}
.fm-line{height:5px;border-radius:3px;margin-bottom:7px}
.fp-live-badge{position:absolute;top:16px;left:16px;background:var(--ink);color:var(--cream);font-size:.68rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:5px 10px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px}
.fp-live-dot{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:#6BCB77;box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(107,203,119,.7);animation:pulseDot 2s ease-in-out infinite}
.fp-info{padding:3rem;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;background:var(--paper)}
.fp-year{font-size:.72rem;color:var(--ink-light);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:.75rem}
.fp-title{font-family:var(--ff-display);font-size:2.2rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin-bottom:.35rem}
.fp-sub{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--gold);font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.04em;margin-bottom:1.25rem}
.fp-desc{color:var(--ink-mid);font-size:.92rem;line-height:1.75;margin-bottom:1.75rem}
.fp-tech{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-bottom:2rem}
.t-badge{font-size:.74rem;padding:4px 10px;border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--ink-light);letter-spacing:.02em;transition:all .2s;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px}
.t-badge:hover{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold)}
.t-badge svg{width:12px;height:12px;opacity:.7}
.fp-links{display:flex;gap:10px}
.proj-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1px;background:var(--border)}
.pj-card{background:var(--paper);padding:2rem;transition:all .3s ease;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.pj-card::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:3px;height:0;background:var(--gold);transition:height .4s ease}
.pj-card:hover{background:var(--warm);transform:translateY(-3px)}
.pj-card:hover::before{height:100%}
.pj-num{font-family:var(--ff-display);font-size:3rem;font-weight:900;color:var(--gold-pale);line-height:1;margin-bottom:1rem;display:block;transition:color .3s}
.pj-card:hover .pj-num{color:rgba(184,148,63,.35)}
.pj-title{font-family:var(--ff-serif);font-size:1.2rem;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:.25rem}
.pj-sub{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--gold);font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.04em;margin-bottom:.75rem}
.pj-desc{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--ink-mid);line-height:1.7;margin-bottom:1.25rem}
.pj-tech{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px;margin-bottom:1.25rem}
.pj-status{font-size:.68rem;padding:3px 8px;border:1px solid;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;display:inline-block}
.ps-live{color:#4a7c59;border-color:#4a7c59;background:rgba(74,124,89,.08)}
.ps-acad{color:var(--rust);border-color:var(--rust);background:rgba(139,69,19,.06)}
.ps-hw{color:var(--ink-light);border-color:var(--border)}

/* ── EDUCATION ── */
#education{background:var(--cream)}
.edu-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr;gap:6rem}
.timeline{position:relative;padding-left:2.5rem}
.timeline::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;top:8px;bottom:40px;width:1px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--gold),var(--border))}
.tl-item{position:relative;margin-bottom:3rem;transition:transform .3s ease}
.tl-item:hover{transform:translateX(6px)}
.tl-item::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:-2.85rem;top:7px;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--paper);border:1.5px solid var(--border);transition:all .3s}
.tl-item:hover::before{border-color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-pale)}
.tl-item.cur::before{background:var(--gold);border-color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(184,148,63,.15)}
.tl-year{font-size:.72rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:5px}
.tl-deg{font-family:var(--ff-serif);font-size:1.1rem;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:3px;line-height:1.3}
.tl-school{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--ink-mid);margin-bottom:2px}
.tl-loc{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--ink-light)}
.lang-title{font-family:var(--ff-serif);font-size:1.4rem;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:2rem}
.lang-item{margin-bottom:1.5rem}
.lang-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:8px}
.lang-name{font-size:.9rem;font-weight:500}
.lang-lvl{font-size:.75rem;color:var(--ink-light);letter-spacing:.04em}
.lang-track{height:3px;background:var(--border)}
.lang-fill{height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold),var(--gold-light));transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform 1.5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
.lang-fill.on{transform:scaleX(1)}
.open-box{margin-top:2.5rem;border:1px solid var(--border);padding:2rem;position:relative;background:var(--warm)}
.open-box::after{content:'DISPONIBLE';position:absolute;top:-10px;left:1.5rem;background:var(--warm);font-size:.65rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.15em;color:var(--gold);padding:0 8px}
.open-box p{font-size:.9rem;color:var(--ink-mid);line-height:1.75;margin-bottom:1.25rem}

/* ── CONTACT ── */
#contact{background:var(--ink);color:var(--cream)}
.contact-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.1fr;gap:6rem;align-items:start}
#contact .s-tag{color:var(--gold-light)}
#contact .s-tag::before{background:var(--gold-light)}
#contact .s-title{color:var(--cream)}
#contact .s-title em{color:var(--gold-light)}
#contact .s-desc{color:rgba(250,248,244,.5);margin-bottom:2.5rem}
.c-links{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.75rem}
.c-link{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:1rem 1.25rem;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);text-decoration:none;color:var(--cream);transition:all .25s}
.c-link:hover{border-color:rgba(184,148,63,.4);background:rgba(184,148,63,.05);transform:translateX(6px)}
.c-icon{width:36px;height:36px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0}
.c-icon svg{width:18px;height:18px}
.c-label{font-size:.72rem;color:rgba(250,248,244,.4);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}
.c-val{font-size:.88rem;font-weight:400;margin-top:1px}
.form-box{background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);padding:2.5rem}
.form-box h3{font-family:var(--ff-serif);font-size:1.4rem;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:1.75rem;color:var(--cream)}
.f-group{margin-bottom:1.25rem}
.f-label{display:block;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(250,248,244,.4);margin-bottom:8px}
.f-input,.f-ta{width:100%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);padding:11px 14px;color:var(--cream);font-family:var(--ff-body);font-size:.88rem;outline:none;transition:border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s;border-radius:0;resize:none}

// ── INTERSECTION OBSERVER ──
const io=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{
  entries.forEach(e=>{
    if(e.isIntersecting){
      e.target.classList.add('vis');
      e.target.querySelectorAll('.stagger').forEach(s=>s.classList.add('vis'));
    }
  });
},{threshold:.08});
document.querySelectorAll('.rv,.rv-left,.rv-right,.stagger,.skill-block').forEach(el=>io.observe(el));

// ── LANG BARS ──
const langIo=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{
  entries.forEach(e=>{
    if(e.isIntersecting){
      e.target.querySelectorAll('.lang-fill').forEach((b,i)=>{
        setTimeout(()=>{b.style.width=(parseFloat(b.dataset.w)*100)+'%';b.classList.add('on')},i*200);
      });
    }
  });
},{threshold:.3});
document.querySelectorAll('#education').forEach(el=>langIo.observe(el));

// ── COUNTER ANIMATION ──
function animCtr(el,target,dur){
  let v=0;const step=target/((dur/1000)*60);
  const tick=()=>{v=Math.min(v+step,target);el.textContent=Math.floor(v);if(v<target)requestAnimationFrame(tick)};
  tick();
}
const cio=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{
  entries.forEach(e=>{
    if(e.isIntersecting){
      e.target.querySelectorAll('.counter').forEach(c=>animCtr(c,parseInt(c.dataset.target),1200));
      cio.unobserve(e.target);
    }
  });
},{threshold:.5});
document.querySelectorAll('.hero-stats').forEach(el=>cio.observe(el));

// ── TILT on skill blocks ──
document.querySelectorAll('.skill-block').forEach(card=>{
  card.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{
    const r=card.getBoundingClientRect();
    const rx=(e.clientY-r.top-r.height/2)/r.height*5;
    const ry=-(e.clientX-r.left-r.width/2)/r.width*5;
    card.style.transform=`perspective(700px) rotateX(${rx}deg) rotateY(${ry}deg) translateZ(6px)`;
    card.style.transition='transform .08s';
  });
  card.addEventListener('mouseleave',()=>{
    card.style.transform='perspective(700px) rotateX(0) rotateY(0) translateZ(0)';
    card.style.transition='transform .5s ease,background .3s';
  });
});

// ── MAGNETIC buttons ──
document.querySelectorAll('.btn-ink').forEach(btn=>{
  btn.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{
    const r=btn.getBoundingClientRect();
    btn.style.transform=`translate(${(e.clientX-r.left-r.width/2)*.18}px,${(e.clientY-r.top-r.height/2)*.18}px) translateY(-2px)`;
  });
  btn.addEventListener('mouseleave',()=>{btn.style.transform='';});
});

// ── FORMULAIRE EMAILJS ──
const EMAILJS_SERVICE_ID  = "service_8k8a0ol";
const EMAILJS_TEMPLATE_ID = "template_jwrmkms";

function handleForm(btn) {

  const nom     = document.getElementById('f-nom').value.trim();
  const email   = document.getElementById('f-email').value.trim();
  const sujet   = document.getElementById('f-sujet').value.trim();
  const message = document.getElementById('f-message').value.trim();

  if (!nom || !email || !sujet || !message) {
    btn.textContent = '⚠ Remplis tous les champs';
    btn.classList.add('error');
    btn.disabled = true;

    setTimeout(() => {
      btn.textContent = 'Envoyer le message →';
      btn.classList.remove('error');
      btn.disabled = false;
    }, 3000);

    return;
  }

  const emailRegex = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
  if (!emailRegex.test(email)) {
    btn.textContent = '⚠ Email invalide';
    btn.classList.add('error');
    btn.disabled = true;

    setTimeout(() => {
      btn.textContent = 'Envoyer le message →';
      btn.classList.remove('error');
      btn.disabled = false;
    }, 3000);

    return;
  }

  btn.textContent = 'Envoi en cours...';
  btn.disabled = true;

  console.log({ nom, email, sujet, message });

  emailjs.send(EMAILJS_SERVICE_ID, EMAILJS_TEMPLATE_ID, {
    nom: nom,
    email: email,
    sujet: sujet,
    message: message
  })
  .then(() => {
    btn.textContent = '✓ Message envoyé !';
    btn.classList.add('sent');
    btn.disabled = false;

    document.getElementById('f-nom').value = '';
    document.getElementById('f-email').value = '';
    document.getElementById('f-sujet').value = '';
    document.getElementById('f-message').value = '';

    setTimeout(() => {
      btn.textContent = 'Envoyer le message →';
      btn.classList.remove('sent');
    }, 5000);
  })
  .catch((err) => {
    console.error('EmailJS error:', err);
    btn.textContent = '✗ Erreur — réessaie';
    btn.classList.add('error');
    btn.disabled = false;

    setTimeout(() => {
      btn.textContent = 'Envoyer le message →';
      btn.classList.remove('error');
    }, 4000);
  });
}
